_doc: The in-match HUD layout, read from the Figma SCREEN frame rather than from the component page.

_source.note: Child coordinates are frame-local, so they are already canvas space. No offset arithmetic.

_authority: For POSITION, this file wins over every other source. The component page (6:48) is authoritative for a component's ART and SIZE; it says nothing about where the component sits, because a component page has no screen. Anyone placing a widget reads this file.

_corrections._doc: Four placements I asserted from the component page alone, before reading the screen frame. Recorded because the wrong ones were already handed to build lanes.
_corrections.vitals: I said TOP-LEFT. It is TOP-CENTRE: x=503.33, and 503.33 + 273.33/2 = 640.0, the exact horizontal centre. It is also an ARC, not a bar - the frame name says 'arc, not trapezoid', constant thickness 16, sag 2.7. A straight progress bar is the wrong primitive.
_corrections.match_state: I said TOP-CENTRE. It is BOTTOM-CENTRE at y=622. It is also NOT exactly centred: x=474.67 w=302 puts its centre at 625.67, which is 14.33px left of 640. Recorded as measured, not rounded to centre - if that is a design intent it must stay, and if it is a slip it belongs to whoever owns the frame.
_corrections.equipment_tray: I said BOTTOM-LEFT. It is BOTTOM-RIGHT at (940,580). Worse, the frame is ONE 280x110 unit named 'Loadout Tray' holding grenades AND weapon AND ammo AND the stowed weapon - which I had split across two classes, UBREquipmentTray and UBRAmmoBlock, on the assumption they were opposite corners. They are the same corner and arguably one widget.
_corrections.killfeed: Bottom-LEFT at (60,455), 340x76 - not the top-right a killfeed usually occupies. Three rows at pitch 24, row height 20.

health.rule: HIDDEN until damaged; fades 3s after shields full

vitals.art_size_conflict: The exported component art is 277x35; this frame measures 273.33x34. Different by ~3.7px. Neither has been reconciled - do not average them.

reticle.note: Exactly centred (620+20=640, 340+20=360). Fill and stroke are SEPARATE: outline opacity 0.6, thickness 1.0.

art_sizes._rule: size encodes spread - the 40x40 slot here is the anchor box, not a clamp

damage_wheel.note: Concentric with the reticle. Red, appears on damage, decays.

match_state.note: BarSelf is 60 wide and BarThem 44 - the bars are PROPORTIONAL to score, so those are sample values, not layout constants.

killfeed.note: Row count 3 is what the frame draws; it is NOT evidence of the pool size.

loadout_tray._warning: ONE frame, four concerns. Splitting it into classes is a decision nobody has recorded.

equipment.rule: cooldown band FILLS UP and uses-remaining is printed on it

weapon._silhouette_note: ORIGINAL ART per the frame name

motion_tracker._warning: TILTED. A -9.3deg render transform on a live gameplay readout - blips must counter-rotate or the tracker lies about bearing. Nothing in Source/ produces its data (BP65).

interaction_prompt._status: NOT EXPORTED and no C++ class exists. Unclaimed surface.

objective_waypoint._status: NOT EXPORTED and no C++ class exists. World-anchored, so 880,250 is a SAMPLE position, not a layout constant.
objective_waypoint._related: Node 23:2 is an objective banner, 326x41.33, whose sample string is a Halo campaign line - rename before use.

_unclaimed: interaction_prompt - drawn in the frame, no art exported, no class
objective_waypoint - drawn in the frame, no art exported, no class
damage_wheel - art exported (HUD_Feedback_DamageDir 40x42) but the frame wants 120x120; the export is the hitmarker, NOT the wheel
